summary.text: Kristine Perez is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 16 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a registered nurse.

paragraphs.text: Kristine Perez lives in New Hampshire and has worked as a registered nurse in cardiac intensive care, the emergency room and the recovery room, according to Ballotpedia.
She served on the Hollis/Brookline school board.
Ballotpedia lists her House tenure as beginning in 2022, and she was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
